messages:
Anika: Quick sync - proposal for a condensed-fanout fallback when tenant fanout budgets are hit. Aim: show SLO alerts in console but avoid mass pings.
Ravi: So runtime chooses immediate vs condensed digest based on per-tenant budget, right?
Beck: Yep. Track `fanout_budget` (tokens/hour). Immediate alert = 1 token, digest = 5 tokens. If budget insufficient -> condensed digest.
Jo: Digest must be actionable: top-3 SLOs, severity, link to incident, TTL + ack link.
Anika: Console UX: show current `budget_remaining` and a preview button to list effective recipients.
Ravi: API change: extend POST /api/v1/notify-preview to return `fanout_mode`, `budget_remaining`, and `would_be_recipients`. Backwards compatible (missing field => shared/immediate).
Beck: Telemetry: emit `slo.notify.fanout_mode` (immediate|condensed|blocked), `slo.notify.digest_count`, and `slo.notify.effective_count` with labels tenant, slo_id, ownership_mode. Sample 100% for first 72h.
Jo: Safety bypass: always immediate for severity=P0 or if `slo.impact.confidence` > 0.8 across >3 tenants. Define exact rule in docs.
Ravi: Rollout: feature flag via rollout-service, 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. For each step, run 24h telemetry checks: if time-to-ack increases >30% or `effective_count` drops >40% for any critical tenant, roll back.
Anika: Ops alerts: trigger if `slo.notify.fanout_mode==condensed` for >10% tenants >30m, or if `effective_count` drops >70% for any prod tenant in rollout.
Beck: Tests: unit for budget math, integration for preview contract, e2e sim that fires 200 quick alerts to validate digest grouping.
rollout-bot: rollout started: condensed-fanout-v1 -> 1% (ok).
Anika: I'll add UI copy: "Condensed mode groups alerts to reduce noisy pings. P0 alerts still bypass." Sync tomorrow 10:00 to review first telemetry. :rocket:
